bloques: STEAMbit blocks: sensors, outputs, motors and screens.
bloques.bluetoothActivado:
True if the last value the app sent with this label is not "0" and not
empty. Works with the app switch (values 1/0).
bloques.bluetoothAlConectarse: Run code when the STEAMbit app connects.
bloques.bluetoothAlDesconectarse: Run code when the STEAMbit app disconnects.
bloques.bluetoothAlRecibir: Run code every time the app sends a value with this label.
bloques.bluetoothAppConectada: True while the STEAMbit app is connected.
bloques.bluetoothBotonPresionado: True while button A or B of the app joystick screen is pressed.
bloques.bluetoothCruceta:
True if the d-pad of the app (differential drive screen) points this
way. The d-pad sends only a direction, no speed.
bloques.bluetoothEnviarEvento:
Send an event to the app (it shows up in the app monitor).
Letters, numbers and _ only.
bloques.bluetoothEnviarNumero:
Send a number to the app. Shows up in gauges, digits and charts that
use this label.
bloques.bluetoothEnviarSiNo: Send true/false to the app (1/0, for a status indicator).
bloques.bluetoothEnviarTexto: Send a text to the app (for example to a terminal).
bloques.bluetoothJoystick:
Position of the 360° joystick of the app (omni drive screen), from
-100 to 100. y is forward/backward, x is left/right, rotation is the
spin control.
bloques.bluetoothMostrarNombre:
Scroll the Bluetooth name of this board on the screen (for example
ZAVIG for "BBC micro:bit [zavig]"), the same name the app shows.
bloques.bluetoothNumero: The last number the app sent with this label (0 if nothing arrived yet).
bloques.bluetoothPausaEnvios:
Minimum pause between messages sent to the app. 100 ms is tested to
lose no bytes; lower values send faster but may lose data.
bloques.bluetoothTexto: The last text the app sent with this label ("" if nothing arrived yet).
bloques.bluetoothVelocidadRueda:
Speed for one wheel of a two-wheel robot driven with the 360°
joystick, from -100 to 100. Plug it into your motor block.
bloques.boton: Returns 1 if the button is pressed and 0 if it is not.
bloques.helice: Turns the propeller on or off.
bloques.joystick: Reads the joystick position on the X or Y axis (−100 to 100) or its button (1 = pressed, 0 = released).
bloques.led: Turns the LED on or off.
bloques.ledIntensidad: Sets the LED brightness: 0 = off, 1023 = maximum.
bloques.motorMulticolor: Spins one motor. Use + to choose the speed (0 to 100).
bloques.movimientoCm: Moves forward or backward the chosen centimeters, then stops.
bloques.movimientoGirar: Turns the robot the chosen degrees, then stops.
bloques.movimientoSimple: Moves the robot at the chosen speed (0 to 100).
bloques.oledBorrar: Clears everything on the OLED screen.
bloques.oledEscribir: Writes text or a number on the OLED screen.
bloques.puertoToAnalogPin: Converts a port to its analog pin.
bloques.puertoToDigitalPin: Converts a port to its digital pin.
bloques.seguidorDeLinea: Detects whether that side of the follower is on the black line.
bloques.sensorColorDetecta: Detects whether the sensor sees the chosen color.
bloques.servo: Moves the servo to the chosen angle (0 to 180°).
bloques.tiraRgb: Sets the color of each of the 6 LEDs on the strip.
bloques.tiraRgbAjustada: Lights the whole strip with a mix of red, green and blue (0 to 255).
bloques.tiraRgbApagarTodos: Turns off all the LEDs on the strip.
bloques.ultrasonido: Measures the distance to an object in centimeters (0 to 200).
